args.subject: Acknowledgement of Quotation Q-1042
args.body:
Dear Shakti Precision Components,

Thank you for submitting Quotation Q-1042 dated for:
- Item A: 9mm brass casings, 500 units @ INR 120
- Item B: Field radio batteries, 200 units @ INR 850

We acknowledge receipt of your quotation. Our procurement team will review the offer against current stock levels and operational requirements. The quoted validity of 30 days and delivery timeline of 3 weeks from Purchase Order are noted.

We will revert with our decision within the validity period.

Regards,
Procurement Office
Defence Supply Division
